player_prompt.intro:
A si Jokkondirgo {player_id} e go'o {num_rounds}-rounde e IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Ee go'o, o ina lamminde nde {min_guess} e {max_guess}.
Ee go'o maa jokkondirden, target woni (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
Ee jokkondirgo on ina lamminde nde maa nguurndee e target woni o mo o woni ee rounde.
Ina jawdi e lamminde nde e format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format je wala naffuda; don na wi'a no a footi wurtinugo: [<number>].

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: Ko ɓe waɗi fuu ɗum boɗɗum.
